plan.notes: Transcribed from the official Mendocino College Vocational Nursing Program Application Handbook for Fall 2026, 'VOCATIONAL NURSING CERTIFICATE REQUIRED COURSES' table (p. 8): LVN 101 (17.5 units, Prerequisite: Acceptance into the program), LVN 102 (17 units, Prerequisite: LVN 101), LVN 103 (17.5 units, Prerequisite: LVN 102); 'TOTAL LVN CERTIFICATE UNITS 52'. The catalog describes it as three semesters of theory and clinical work; each course is completed in one semester. Course titles (Vocational Nursing I/II/III) per the 2026-2027 catalog COURSES section. The LVN program is new to Mendocino College (relocated from Ukiah Adult School), anticipated start Fall 2026.
